import { LitElement, html, svg } from "lit";

// tabler:brand-github - generated by DesignHub. Set size and color, or size with font-size and inherit the text color.
export class BrandGithubIcon extends LitElement {
  static properties = {
    size: { type: String },
    color: { type: String },
  };

  declare size: string;
  declare color: string;

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.size = "1em";
    this.color = "currentColor";
  }

  render() {
    return html`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width=${this.size} height=${this.size} viewBox="0 0 1000 1000" aria-hidden="true" style="color: ${this.color}">${svg`<g transform="translate(-62.5 93.75) scale(31.25)"><defs><linearGradient id="fade9"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f00"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#00f"/></linearGradient></defs><style>@media print{.a{fill:red}}</style><path class="a" fill="url(#fade9)" stroke="currentColor" d="M0 0h24v24H0z"/><use xlink:href="#fade9"/><text>\`\${x}\` \\ {{ y }}</text></g>`}</svg>`;
  }
}

customElements.define("brand-github-icon", BrandGithubIcon);

declare global {
  interface HTMLElementTagNameMap {
    "brand-github-icon": BrandGithubIcon;
  }
}
